items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Yeah, he's in Gary, Louisiana. That's me, I'm afraid. Gary. Gary, huh? Gary, Indiana, somewhere. Gary, Indiana?

ctx.x: It wasn't mine, it was my oldest brother's pants. Oh. The base pair of my oldest brother was. What was his name? Joe Parker. Joe.
Yeah, he's in Gary, Louisiana. That's me, I'm afraid. Gary. Gary, huh? Gary, Indiana, somewhere. Gary, Indiana?
Somewhere up there. Well, we'll have to write him a letter. Maybe we can contact him. Next time I go up north, I'll look him up.
